description:
Remove the MCP server and its integrations, consolidate repository quality gates, and preserve historical gate evidence.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The MCP server, its exclusive Rust metadata and tests, and its build, security, release, and profile integrations are absent.
- [hard] REQ-02: Active documentation and release plans describe the remaining product surfaces without MCP server instructions.
- [hard] REQ-03: CLI JSON and schema contracts and other product capabilities remain available and verified.
- [hard] REQ-04: Historical issue records, evidence, and charter decisions remain intact.
- [hard] REQ-05: Repository-local tests, fmt, clippy, and tdd-reminder gates and live bindings are absent; cargo-ci retains formatting, lint, and test coverage.
- [hard] REQ-06: Historical gate runs remain readable after the gate definition and issue binding are removed, independent of issue state; reopening with undefined required gates is rejected.


Historical document references to retired files are pinned to their pre-retirement revision; their paths, labels, types, and issue bodies remain preserved.
title: Retire the MCP server and consolidate quality gates
